verdict.rationale: Puzzle has a documented, versioned REST API with a published OpenAPI 3.0.3 spec and a ReadMe reference that includes a balances endpoint, which plausibly covers trial-balance-style data. However, no evidence shows API endpoints for pulling the full general ledger. The full GL export in CSV/Excel is documented only as an in-app export, and API access is request-gated. Missing for 10: documented API endpoint for full general ledger/journal lines, explicit trial balance endpoint semantics, documented open-format (CSV/JSON) API output for GL/TB, self-serve API access, independent corroboration.

support.subject: As a developer, I can pull the full general ledger and trial balance through a documented API in open formats

citations.quote: Puzzle publishes a machine-readable OpenAPI 3.0.3 document (info title "Puzzle Api", server https://app.puzzle.io/rest/v0) on its app domain
Our API was originally architected for deep platform-to-platform integrations.
The ReadMe-hosted API reference ships the live "Try It!" console per endpoint
